html: The Ngalea, also spelt Ngalia, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Great Victoria Desert, near the border of Western Australia and South Australia. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815. They belong to the Western Desert cultural bloc. Their neighbours included the Nakako to the north, the Pitjantjatjara to the northeast and the Mirning on the Nullarbor to the south. In the 1950s Britain tested atomic bombs at Maralinga, east of this country, in the Maralinga tests, and desert people were moved away from the area.
